name: Puri Jagannath Temple
description: 65-meter towering sacred Rekha Deula, Jagamohana, Nata Mandapa, and Bhoga Mandapa crowned by the eight-spoke Nilachakra and sacred Patitapabana flag.

hotspots.title: Nilachakra & Patitapabana Flag
hotspots.description: The eight-spoked sacred discus forged from ashtadhatu atop the 65m shikhara, adorned with the daily ceremonial flag changed by the Chuda Sevakas.
hotspots.architectural_significance: Crowning metal crest of the monumental Rekha Deula visible across Puri and the Bay of Bengal coastline.

hotspots.title: Bada Deula (Main Sanctum Spire)
hotspots.description: Monumental curvilinear tower rising 65 meters on an elevated stone plinth (Kurma Beda), dominating the sacred skyline.
hotspots.architectural_significance: Pinnacle of mature Kalinga architecture with vertical pagas, rahapaga niches, and amalaka crowning disc.

hotspots.title: Singhadwara (Lion's Gate)
hotspots.description: The majestic eastern portal of the outer Meghnad Pacheri wall guarded by two colossal monolithic crouching stone lions.
hotspots.architectural_significance: Primary ceremonial gateway leading up the historic 22 Baisi Pahacha steps to the inner sanctuary.

reconstruction_notes: Authorized exterior perimeter and architectural skyline reference only. In accordance with sacred sanctum sanctity rules, no interior sanctum geometry is reconstructed or displayed.
surrounding_environment: Grand Road (Bada Danda), sacred temple enclosure, and ocean breeze
